recentItems.title: Government shutdown looms as Congress returns from recess with a packed agenda
recentItems.description:
Congress returns to Washington Monday for the first time in a month with a busy and condensed agenda as lawmakers make their final push to pass bills before the midterm elections.

On the top of the agenda is a short-term government funding bill to avert a pre-election government shutdown. Members of the House of Representatives, all up for re-election, are expected to act quickly on the stopgap funding bill.

recentItems.title: 300,000 Haitian immigrants lose work authorization as Trump administration ends TPS program
recentItems.description: At least 5,000 Haitian immigrants in New York City — and roughly 300,000 across the country — have lost their ability to work legally in the U.S. after the Trump administration ended Temporary Protected Status for Haiti. Businesses that depended on those workers are now struggling to stay open.

recentItems.title: Trump awards Congressional Space Medal to Artemis II astronauts, announces Space Force academy
recentItems.description:
President Donald Trump awarded the Congressional Space Medal of Honor to the Artemis II astronauts while outlining the administration's vision for the future of space.

The awards were given Friday to NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Canadian Space Agency astronaut Jeremy Hansen during a ceremony at the Johnson Space Center on Friday.
